title: Design: Board View shows No technicians yet when there are no technicians
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Use a test location where no staff member has both Time Clock and Technician on, with at least one open work order, no pinned column and no lead on any work order shown.
  • Make sure Assigned to me and the Technician filter are off on Work Orders.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the Board View icon in the display switcher.
  3. Click "Set Up Technicians".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work Orders opens.

Step 2:

  • The board shows the title "No technicians yet" with the text "Turn Technician on for your technicians in Staff to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned."
  • A button reads "Set Up Technicians".
  • The Unassigned column is still shown with the work orders.

Step 3:

  • Settings, Staff opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 18 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R10: “When Board View or Tech View has no technician column or group at all (no technician at the location, no column kept for a non-technician lead under S3-E1 and no pinned column under S3-E2), and neither Assigned to me nor a Technician filter is on, it shows the title "No technicians yet" with the text "Turn Technician on for your technicians in Staff to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned."”
  • S3-R10: “The button the Board View and Tech View PRD (S1-N1d, SV-11555) calls Add Technician reads "Set Up Technicians" and opens the staff list (Settings, Staff), for the same users who see it today.”

From: Chris Ward's answers, Google Sheet "Technician Toggle – questions for Chris Ward (2 Nov 2026)", https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nLKkgSgmtqCYu4eu15_9xN38ml32tDnJls42PPq_A4M, column E, answered 2 Nov 2026 (po-answers-2026-11-02/ANSWERS-Chris-Ward-2026-11-02.md), read 2 Nov 2026

  • Answer 7 (question 7): “7. (c) Keep both sentences. They follow Branko's Work Orders design for this state, which already shipped with two sentences in SV-11555 and passed QA. Technician Toggle only changes the first sentence.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
